name: @tomgrv/app-github-arc
description: GitHub Actions Runner Controller and a runner scale set installed with helm from this repo's chart

GITHUB_ARC_CONFIG_URL.description: Org or repo URL the runners register against (e.g. https://github.com/<org>)

GITHUB_ARC_APP_ID.description: GitHub App id used to register the runners

GITHUB_ARC_APP_INSTALLATION_ID.description: Installation id of that GitHub App

GITHUB_ARC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key of that GitHub App (PEM contents)

ZZ_SECRETS_FILE.description: Owner-only env file holding the credentials the steps generate
